hypothesis: Exterior water routing may contribute to basement moisture.
verification: Confirm sides of house, timing and a water pathway; also assess groundwater, plumbing and condensation.

hypothesis: Indoor exhaust may contribute to attic condensation.
verification: Verify duct termination, season, humidity and moisture distribution; rule out rain entry.

hypothesis: A roof defect could be related to the ceiling staining.
verification: Verify spatial relationship and trace moisture; plumbing or historical staining remain alternatives.

hypothesis: Plumbing leakage could extend beyond the visible finish.
verification: Confirm shared location and moisture readings; concealed damage extent is unknown.

hypothesis: Multiple movement indicators warrant a coordinated structural assessment.
verification: Engineer determines alignment, progression and cause; co-occurrence is not proof of foundation failure.

hypothesis: Restricted airflow is one possible contributor to cooling-system icing.
verification: Technician checks airflow and refrigerant; do not assume a recharge or replacement is needed.
